commands.label: Resume
commands.note: Resume owns recovery admission; unrelated jobs do not gate a commit or undo.

commands.label: Scramble (staged)
commands.note: stages into the operation; the commit is operation.execute H5: atomic workspace edit in lane none; no job-wide busy gate.

commands.label: Undo
commands.note: LI.26: dispatch journal or workspace action from ActionHint through its original permission path, including release confirmation. Restore a recorded slot map only when the target action changed it.

commands.label: Redo
commands.note: LI.26: dispatch journal or workspace action from ActionHint through its original permission path, including release confirmation. Restore a recorded slot map only when the target action changed it.

commands.label: Import a checked log
commands.note: keeps preferences; leaves a recovery checkpoint

commands.label: Apply keymap file
amendment_sources: ADR-D01 (owner, 22 Nov 2026): a keymap is a design-profile change in the layout history (ADR-D01.14)

commands.label: Edit phase turns
commands.note: H5: atomic workspace edit in lane none; no job-wide busy gate.

commands.label: Check full effect
commands.note: Also checks the solver-supplied menu word at the current snapshot, with optional unit and cap; returns all EH-25 fields and chronological prefix coverage. A false step flag is data, not execution refusal. JI.11, JI.32.

commands.label: Preview
commands.note: Also replays the entire literal menu word prefix by prefix at current H3 dependencies into one immutable engine preview. A blocked prefix yields no preview; a false step flag or protection conflict is displayed separately. JI.11, JI.15, JI.32.

commands.label: Execute
commands.note: Also commits a menu word or selected repair as one journal action from its presented fresh preview. Recheck H3 dependencies, literal digest, full-state hash, mode, identity and protection; adopt only the engine-owned end state. Scramble witnesses remain hidden and separate. JI.27, JI.31, JI.32.

commands.label: Stop running check
commands.note: a request; acceptance is not completion

commands.label: Show Actual / After Prepare / After Macro / After Cleanup
Effect scope Macro body / All steps
Add current state as block requirement
Recommendations
commands.note: ranking only; never grants permission or executes

commands.label: Add selected macro to Macro phase
commands.note: Add a menu word or solver-selected correction to the current draft, retaining alphabet, model/menu/order/contract pins, exact expanded length, named spans and provenance. One workspace action; no execution. JI.18-JI.23, JI.32.

commands.label: Save as macro
commands.note: Saving does not select, insert or execute. Also stores menu words as flat ia16 payloads with optional verified named spans, exact expanded length, identity/order/contract pins, origin digest and provenance. JI.18-JI.23, JI.32.

commands.label: Set protection policy (net or strict)
commands.note: invalidates any open preview

commands.label: Twist
commands.note: live only; no preview (ONE.78; owner, 6 November 2026, decision 10)

commands.label: Choose grip anchor
commands.note: DT-M1 C7: replaces bank.select; choosing an anchor does not apply a slot map

commands.label: Apply reviewed grip map
commands.note: DT-M1 K2 and Q3(a): explicit rebind with transported slot order and frames

commands.label: Change key
amendment_sources: ADR-D01 (owner, 22 Nov 2026): a keymap is a design-profile change in the layout history (ADR-D01.14)

commands.label: Save frozen set
commands.note: Saves a set of pieces or positions under a name. A name that holds a saved set is refused with KN5:input.saved_set_exists, and the saved set is kept, unless the invocation carries replace: true, which replaces it (U1-057: replacing a named set stays explicit).
amendment_sources: U1-057; LP2 pull request 337; chapter 13 section 9 (KN5:input.saved_set_exists)

commands.label: Append resolved twist to phase
commands.note: DT-M1 C7: edits a draft only; protection is checked on the complete operation

commands.label: Reset work context
commands.note: Preserves puzzle history, personal tools and protection

commands.label: Open full-model practice copy
commands.note: Explicit fixture action in an isolated practice session; never startup

commands.label: Leave expanded work surface
commands.note: Preserves the two baseline linked views, drafts and previews

commands.label: Adjust workspace layout
commands.note: Applies a stored layout or named workspace (ADR-D01.38): a workspace row whose completion is a step of the layout history, so layout.undo reaches it and session.undo does not (ADR-D01.14). Applying it is the solver's action, a bound entry point or a recorded step; a program may only prepare one as a layout preview.
amendment_sources: ADR-D01 (owner, 22 Nov 2026): a layout change is a workspace step in the layout history (ADR-D01.14, ADR-D01.38)

commands.label: Recover workspace layout
commands.note: Resets a named workspace, or the one in use when layout is not given, to its shipped preset (ADR-D01.38): a step of the layout history (ADR-D01.14).
amendment_sources: ADR-D01 (owner, 22 Nov 2026): a layout change is a workspace step in the layout history (ADR-D01.14, ADR-D01.38)

commands.label: Close innermost transient
commands.note: Escape never stops a job, cancels a preview or drops a draft

commands.label: Copy named result row
commands.note: O9 row copy identifies the result and absolute object; never executes

commands.label: Scrub identified preview
commands.note: Inspect the identified retained or jumbling solver-word preview at a literal prefix position under its preview and revision pins (JI.33, H7). A cancellable view job; the newest request for this target supersedes older work. Never commit or expose hidden scramble prefixes.
amendment_sources: DT-M1 C1, fix-first 2; DT-J1 O10(b); jumbling-interfaces.md JI.33; HANDOFF H15.19

commands.label: Inspect complete pieces and slots in cap
Stage default bindings
amendment_sources: ADR-D01 (owner, 22 Nov 2026): a keymap is a design-profile change in the layout history (ADR-D01.14)

commands.label: Save checked binding edits
amendment_sources: ADR-D01 (owner, 22 Nov 2026): a keymap is a design-profile change in the layout history (ADR-D01.14)

commands.label: Name saved key map
amendment_sources: ADR-D01 (owner, 22 Nov 2026): a keymap is a design-profile change in the layout history (ADR-D01.14)

commands.label: Check selected library effects
commands.note: Explicit inspection under U6-031/2; automated bookkeeping U3-085 contributes no command

commands.label: Expand and check chosen construction
commands.note: Family and parameters chosen by the solver; signed 3 October ruling, no insertion planner

commands.label: Jumble on
commands.note: A5: replay the valid exit-root suffix or a retained word from solved; refuse labels alone. No confirmation key.

commands.label: Jumble off
commands.note: A5: exact reachable label checkpoint only; atomically retain exit poses, certificate and lineage. No confirmation key.

commands.label: Apply menu twist
commands.note: Resolved absolute cap and exact pinned-menu item. Retained items dispatch by mode; jumble items require Jumble on. A live turn has no preview (ONE.78; owner, 6 November 2026, decision 10).

commands.label: Append menu twist to draft
commands.note: Resolve the same pinned letter as the live menu row into the explicitly selected draft phase; no live protection gate or journal undo.

commands.label: Inspect grip status
commands.note: Certified per-grip status and explicit coverage only; no outcomes for unreleased menu items.

commands.label: Read jumbling facts
commands.note: Requested rim, height, unit, cut-cell and seam facts at one input. Total N requires the all-scope seam batch, including off-grip seams. No target selection or ranking.

commands.label: Inspect named cap straddlers
commands.note: Solver-named cap only; full certified straddler set and u, cached by complete input pins. Naming does not mean hover or prefetch.

commands.label: Inspect straddle certificate
commands.note: Inspect a pinned cap/piece certificate and its exact point pair; reject mismatched input. H-05 targets are grips, pieces and certificate points.

commands.label: Check released menu twist
commands.note: Only the released letter, with optional solver-named cap for delta-u. A newer release supersedes the old request. No values for untried twists.

commands.label: Check covers at named cap
commands.note: Completed exact answers in both directions over every meeting cap, with coverage; no top-cap verdict, helpful twist or map mark.

commands.label: List repairs at named cap
commands.note: Only the owner-approved three-twist list, neutral pinned-x then cap order, with x,d,y,z and delta-N. No row selected by default, no ranking, prefetch or execution.

commands.label: Read lattice invariant
commands.note: A5 nu under the pinned C5 convention; undefined off lattice; violated fixed I_a coordinate is a consistency error.

commands.label: Check drafted corrections
commands.note: Predict nu only for the solver-supplied correction IDs and multiplicities. Never compute a combination or reorder the catalogue.

commands.label: Read correction by ID
commands.note: Look up a solver-specified construction in the fixed 36-item catalogue; return pinned literal word and fixed nu row. macro.add inserts it; no automatic selection.

commands.label: Check jumbling checkpoint
commands.note: Explicit retained-checkpoint, label-checkpoint or sticker-test query with its own conclusion. Existing session.checkpoint.save stores evidence; jumble.off performs handoff.

commands.label: Stage jumbling scramble
commands.note: Unavailable until EH-30 owner policy is pinned. Stage an opaque engine-owned word with a separate hidden witness; normal fresh preview and operation.execute commit it. No per-twist solving output.

commands.label: Open a view
commands.note: Opens a further view from a ViewSourceRef. Runs only inside a command the solver invoked; a view cannot open views. An open ViewId refuses with EV3:input.view_id_in_use.

commands.label: Close a view
commands.note: Closes a further view. Global, Local and an unknown view refuse with EV3:input.view_not_closable.

commands.label: Start recording
commands.note: Starts capture of resolved invocations, including refusals, excluding recording.*; a second start refuses with EV4:input.recording_state.

commands.label: Stop recording
commands.note: Ends capture and stores the recording; with no recording it refuses with EV4:input.recording_state.

commands.label: Play a recording
commands.note: Plays view and workspace steps unattended and never a commit. Stops and waits for one user action at commit-lane, confirm, file_check, file, app, exclusive-lane and job rows (EV4.18, PS1.44).

commands.label: Convert a recording
commands.note: Converts a recording to a draft or to source; a step with no form in the target refuses with EV4:input.recording_not_convertible.

commands.label: Write workspace record
commands.note: M6's record write: writes the named record's payload and provenance block as one durable action; the workspace revision and the record's version advance, and the state, the preview slot and the jobs stay. Undo and redo are workspace inverses. The host's provenance reader checks the block at the write. A program may not invoke it (LG3:capability.not_granted). OPEN: the payload's type Json is not frozen.
commands.source: M6 record write; KN5.18, KN5.23, LI.26, PS1.16; joins H-08 at the LP3 freeze (PHS.53)

commands.label: Select theme family
commands.note: Selects a theme family, whose scene looks come with it (ADR-D01.49). Without family the theme follows the Windows light or dark setting, the default (ADR-D01.50). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Tune theme seeds
commands.note: Writes a theme family's ranged seed knobs (tone, contrast, black level, accent hue, grid intensity); only the raw seeds move (ADR-D01.50). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Override colour token
commands.note: Overrides one semantic token, for one theme family when theme is given, as a difference file with a contrast check on save (ADR-D01.50). The colour keeps its value across theme switches and is flagged as an override; a state or encoding role that differs from its shipped colour puts the non-standard colours mark on the view frame (ADR-D01.51). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Reset colour token
commands.note: Resets an overridden token to its token value, for one theme family when theme is given (ADR-D01.51). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Set density preset
commands.note: Selects a preset of the one density token table: compact, default or comfortable; compact ships (ADR-D01.45). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Set type scale
commands.note: Selects a preset of the closed size ramps of the three type roles (ui, content, code); faces and metrics stay the same in every theme family and look, and the ramps are tuned later (ADR-D01.47). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Set motion preset
commands.note: Selects a motion preset of the motion table (H-03). The engine commits before any animation, so a preset never changes state; curves are tuned in G5 (ADR-D01.55). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Set reduced motion
commands.note: Turns reduced motion on or off; it is off by default, and reducing motion never changes state (ADR-D01.55). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Mount script panel
commands.note: Mounts a program's declared panel at one of its declared mount points: palette entry, context action, inspector section, docked panel in a slot, free view or overlay annotation (ADR-D01.30). The panel keeps a stable id in the session store. Capabilities stay with the package's install consent (ADR-D01.32). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Unmount script panel
commands.note: Removes a mounted script panel by its stable id (ADR-D01.30). The main Global and Local pair is not a script panel and stays (ADR-D01.36). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Edit radial menu
commands.note: Edits a user-editable radial menu; an entry may be a command or a .6cs entry and behaves exactly like its palette row (ADR-D01.20). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Pin palette row
commands.note: Pins or unpins a palette row; the palette ranks only by the solver's own recency, frequency and pins (ADR-D01.18). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Alias palette row
commands.note: Sets the solver's aliases for a palette row. An alias is a synonym the palette matches and never renames the command's stable id (ADR-D01.17, ADR-D01.18). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

commands.label: Set explore state
commands.note: Turns the explore state on or off. While it is on, commits are paused and every view frame signals it. It may only pause commits: it never enables or makes a commit, and it changes no command vocabulary or capability (ADR-D01.39). While it is on, every commit row but layout.undo and layout.redo is refused before its token is spent, a run turns it only inside a command the solver invoked, and a restart clears it. Not in the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it.

commands.label: Open preview view
commands.note: Opens the preview view, a free view outside the main pair, on an identified preview: its full collateral effect, witness sequence, effect on every orbit and on protection, with a before-to-after scrub and move-by-move stepping (ADR-D01.10). The main Global and Local views keep the committed state with a pending marker. It prepares no preview and commits nothing.

commands.label: Pin free view
commands.note: Pins or unpins a free view, the preview view included, to the source its binding chip names: committed state, a preview, a saved reference or a history position (ADR-D01.42, ADR-D01.43). Global and Local always show the committed state (ADR-D01.40).

commands.label: Compare with A/B wipe
commands.note: Compares a free view's source with another binding (committed state, a preview, a saved reference or a history position) by an A/B wipe; without against the wipe ends (ADR-D01.42).

commands.label: Set history dock mode
commands.note: Shows the History dock as the move history in .6cs (one expandable header row per transaction) or as the plain list of named transactions (ADR-D01.15). Display only: it moves no rollback cursor.

commands.label: Undo layout change
commands.note: Undoes the layout history's newest step: a completion of a row whose undo class is layout (theme, density, type, motion, keymap, panel, radial, palette and layout changes), from LI.9's ActionHint of that history, as session.undo does for the move history; neither history reaches the other's steps (ADR-D01.14). Default key Ctrl+Alt+Z. It journals as an undo whose row is layout.undo, a workspace inverse with equal puzzle hashes, and the explore state does not pause it (ADR-D01.39). Camera and view-filter steps are not journaled yet.

commands.label: Redo layout change
commands.note: Redoes the layout history's newest undone step: a completion of a row whose undo class is layout (theme, density, type, motion, keymap, panel, radial, palette and layout changes), from LI.9's ActionHint of that history, as session.redo does for the move history; neither history reaches the other's steps (ADR-D01.14). Default key Ctrl+Alt+Y. It journals as a redo whose row is layout.redo, a workspace inverse with equal puzzle hashes, and the explore state does not pause it (ADR-D01.39). Camera and view-filter steps are not journaled yet.

services.note: Capture one immutable input under the caller's grants and run/epoch ownership.
Release the supplied snapshot owner; no durable action.
Continue the admitted stream in its original invocation and lane; no new admission.
Create a charged owning alias of immutable data under the caller's grants.
Release the named owner; acknowledgement does not assert physical deallocation.
Look up the permitted command/request receipt without a new invocation or replay.
Read the permitted result for the original command/job binding; never rerun it.
Given session/epoch and direction: undo | redo, read one ActionHint or none for that direction in the shared durable order; the hint reserves nothing and grants no permission.
Publish to the resolved ViewId under the view grant. Scheduled publication finalizes its original invocation and lane generation; standalone publication uses normal admission.

reads.order: The host prices the read first and refuses a malformed argument there, and on the Full bridge a declared type it does not serve, at the cost of the read's step only. The run then charges the tariff and the host answers; a refusal after the charge keeps the charge.

types.Recipe: Word | List<Int> | List<record { kind: Text, moves: Word, node: Nat, orbit: Nat, sign: Int }>

tariff.jumbling: 177,120, one unit per piece, per pass over a state; result bound 2^24 for every row

rows.answer: List<record { home: List<Nat>, orbit: Int, piece: Nat, position: Int, slots: List<Nat> }>
rows.tariff: 259,800 + 20 per piece named; result bound: that many of the largest records
rows.note: Pieces named by home position, 0 to 177,119, with repeats; any list of integers, such as a Set<Nat>. Each record gives the piece's orbit (-1 for a fixed cell centre), its home slots, the slots that hold its stickers now and the position whose slots hold them all (-1 when they are split).

rows.answer: List<Nat>
rows.tariff: 1 per slot named; result bound: that many of the largest labels
rows.note: Slots named, 0 to 259,799, with repeats; the label each holds at the head.

rows.answer: record { destination: List<Nat>, expansion_sha256: Text, moved_pieces: Nat, moved_stickers: Nat, net_sha256: Text, primitive_count: Nat, source: List<Nat>, support: List<record { orbit: Int, pieces: Nat, stickers: Nat }> }
rows.tariff: 259,800 + 1 per primitive of the recipe's expansion (0 when the kernel refuses the recipe); result bound: the largest answer with the declared fields
rows.note: A recipe's net source-to-destination map, its digests and lengths and its support per orbit; it reads no state. The kernel's own refusal of a recipe passes through.

rows.argument: record { lock: record { kind: Text, labels: List<Nat>, slots: List<Nat> }, mode: Text, recipe: Recipe }, with limit: Nat for Strict only
rows.answer: record { checked: Nat, conflicts: List<Nat>, expansion_sha256: Text, level: Text, primitive_count: Nat, refused_prefix: Int }
rows.tariff: the lock's pairs + the expansion's primitives + 259,800 x (generators + 1), with 0 generators for Net and min(primitives, 1,200) for Strict; result bound: the empty answer and one slot per pair
rows.note: A captured lock judged Net or Strict against a recipe at the head; mode is net or strict, and level is labels. The kernel's own refusal of a recipe passes through.

rows.answer: record { conflicts: List<Nat>, expansion_sha256: Text, level: Text, net_sha256: Text, primitive_count: Nat, protected: List<Nat>, refused_prefix: Int }
rows.tariff: 2 x 259,800 + 2 per primitive of the expansion (0 when the kernel refuses the recipe); result bound: the largest replay answer
rows.note: A recipe replayed prefix by prefix at the head under the session's protected orbits, keeping the head; level is labels. The kernel's own refusal of a recipe passes through.

rows.answer: record { buffers: List<Nat>, family: Text, orbit: Nat, position: Nat, setups: List<record { frame: List<Nat>, node: Nat, setup: Word }>, table_sha256: Text }
rows.tariff: 259,800 + 3 x 259,800 per setup the named position has in the table; result bound: that many of the largest setups
rows.note: The certified setups for a target the solver names, in the table's order, none ranked; only the setup-search exception reads it. Without a certified table from the host it is not granted.

rows.answer: record { first: Nat, second: Nat, steps: Nat }
rows.tariff: 1; result bound: three integers
rows.note: The fewest face steps between two cells, 0 to 599; model data. The command row of the same name is its entry.

rows.answer: record { cell: Nat, layer: Nat, pieces: Nat, slots: Nat }
rows.tariff: 259,800; result bound: the largest answer
rows.note: The counts of a layer predicate: the positions with a home slot layer face steps from cell, and their home slots; model data. The command row of the same name is its entry.

rows.answer: record { cell: Nat, layer: Nat, pieces: List<Nat>, slots: List<Nat> }
rows.tariff: 259,800 + 177,120 + 259,800; result bound: an answer holding every position and slot
rows.note: The members that filter.preview counts, by home position and home slot, in increasing order; model data. The command row of the same name prepares its predicate.

rows.answer: List<record { orbit: Int, pieces: List<Nat> }>
rows.tariff: 259,800 + 7,200 per orbit named; result bound: that many of the largest records
rows.note: The pieces of named orbits, -1 to 34 (-1 for the fixed cell centres), with repeats; model data, the orbit that the positions row gives each piece at every state.

rows.argument: record { cursor: Text, from: Text, limit: Nat }
rows.answer: record { entries: List<record { event: Text, exit: Text, kind: Text, letters: Nat, solved: Bool }>, next: Text }
rows.tariff: 1 per event of the page asked (limit, at most 4,096); result bound: limit of the largest entries and the longest cursor
rows.note: KN4.3's journal query: a page from from (the head when empty) toward the start on that event's line, newest first, limit 1 to 4,096. It answers with Jumble on or off, replays nothing and changes nothing.

rows.answer: record { lattice_key: Text, poses: Map<Text,record { branches: List<Int>, count: Nat, domain: Text, heights: List<Nat> }> }
rows.tariff: 1 pass
rows.note: Per exact pose its domain, branches and heights, with the lattice key.

rows.answer: record { max_above_6: List<Nat>, n_0: Nat, n_2: Nat, n_4: Nat, n_6: Nat, n_above_6: Nat }
rows.tariff: 1 pass
rows.note: The height counts n_0, n_2, n_4, n_6 and above 6, with the maximum above 6.

rows.answer: record { complete: Bool, first_refused: List<Nat>, rows: List<record { after: Text, max_left_height: List<Nat>, phi_after: List<Nat> }>, start: record { digest: Text, max_left_height: Nat, phi: Nat } }
rows.tariff: 1 + 1 per letter of the word
rows.note: A menu word replayed letter by letter at the head: each prefix's pose digest, left height and Phi, or the first refused prefix.

rows.answer: record { admissible: Bool, applied_letters: Nat, lattice_pieces_lifted_off: List<Nat>, others: Nat, others_exact: List<Nat>, others_landed: List<Nat>, unit_on_lattice: List<Nat>, unit_size: List<Nat> }
rows.tariff: 1 + 1 per letter of the word (the unit adds none)
rows.note: A whole word's observation for a unit the solver names, not an existence test. The units entry reads it with others_changed_ids, unit and unit_landed in place of unit_on_lattice and unit_size.

rows.argument: record { mode: Text, pieces: List<Nat>, word: MenuWord }
rows.answer: record { first_refused_prefix: List<Nat>, level: Text, mode: Text, pieces: List<Nat>, protected: List<Nat>, verdict: Text }
rows.tariff: 1 + 1 per letter of the word (the pieces add none)
rows.note: Net or Strict for named pieces against a menu word at level poses; mode is net or strict. The derivation's own refusal passes through.

rows.answer: record { reason: List<Text>, values: List<Int> }
rows.tariff: 1 pass
rows.note: nu at the head in A5's fixed C5 convention, or its reason when it is undefined off the lattice; no correction is selected. nu's own refusal passes through.

rows.answer: record { reason: List<Text>, values: List<Int> }
rows.tariff: 1 + 1 per entry of the drafted set
rows.note: nu after the solver's drafted set of correction IDs and multiplicities. The check's own refusal passes through.

rows.answer: record { totals: List<record { aligned: Nat, off_grip_mismatches: Nat, on_grip_mismatches: Nat, total_N: Nat }> }
rows.tariff: 2 passes, for one cap or for "all"
rows.note: The seam totals for a cap or for "all", including off-grip cells; LP3's library reads "all".

rows.answer: record { complete: Bool, digest: Text, grip_n: List<Nat>, grip_n_undefined: List<Text>, rows: List<record { A_c: List<Nat>, F_c: List<Nat>, In_c: List<Nat>, N_c: List<Nat>, Out_c: List<Nat>, at_floor: List<Bool>, blocked: List<Bool>, cap: Nat, status: Text, undefined: List<Text> }> }
rows.tariff: 601 passes: 1 + one per cap (600)
rows.note: Per cap N_c, In_c, Out_c, A_c, F_c, blocked and floor, each with its definedness.

rows.answer: record { answers: List<record { c_covers_d: record { counts: List<record { aligned_inside: Nat, aligned_outside: Nat, inside: Nat, outside: Nat }>, reason: List<Text>, straddlers: List<Nat> }, cap: Nat, d_covers_c: record { counts: List<record { aligned_inside: Nat, aligned_outside: Nat, inside: Nat, outside: Nat }>, reason: List<Text>, straddlers: List<Nat> } }>, domain: List<Nat>, input_digest: Text, message: List<Text>, parameters: record { cap: Nat, threshold: Nat }, status: Text }
rows.tariff: 82 passes: 1 + the named cap and its 80 meeting caps
rows.note: Covers at a cap the solver names, in both directions; a blocked or closed cap answers status error, not a refusal.

rows.answer: record { family: Text, id: Nat, letters: List<List<Nat>>, row: List<Nat> }
